## Latest Rust Version

The latest release is **Rust 1.93.1** (February 12, 2026) — a patch/bugfix release on top of **1.93.0** (January 22, 2026).

---

### Rust 1.93.1 — Bug fixes only

- Fixed internal compiler error in `rustfmt` (keyword recovery regression)
- Fixed false-positive `clippy::panicking_unwrap` warning on field access with implicit deref
- Fixed file descriptor leak on `wasm32-wasip2` target

---

### Rust 1.93.0 — Key features

- **`asm!` cfg attributes** — individual lines in `asm!` blocks can now use `#[cfg(...)]`, no more duplicating entire blocks for conditional compilation
- **Global allocator improvement** — allocators written in Rust can now safely use `thread_local!` and `std::thread::current()`
- **musl 1.2.5 bundled** — better DNS resolver reliability for static Linux binaries (`x86_64`, `aarch64`)
- **21 stabilized APIs** — includes `MaybeUninit` slice methods, unchecked integer ops, array conversion utilities

---

> Source: [blog.rust-lang.org](https://blog.rust-lang.org)
